figurative_meaning_en: In a negative sense, misdeeds or evil actions
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই কীর্তিকলাপের জন্য তাকে শাস্তি দেওয়া হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: He will be punished for these evil actions.
note: The idiom often implies notorious or scandalous behavior in colloquial Bengali usage.
